Results.ReviewText: I've never owned a weber kettle in my over ten years of grilling and smoking.  Until one day, my wife surprised me with the "deep ocean blue" 22" Master-Touch.  I must say, there's a reason these are classic grills.  It's very versatile and easy to control.
Results.Title: Great and Classic

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Master-Touch is it. I also own a Weber Genesis Propane grill and I am proud of it. There are convenience and control realities with Propane grills that I enjoy. They serve their purpose. I also own a highly rated durable charcoal grill that is built with extreme longevity in mind. The problem with that charcoal grill is that it will not get hot enough for a spectacular sear on a steak. Way more than half the occasions I grill our meals Ribeye or Filet Mignon are the protein of choice, so a good sear is very important to me. Because my charcoal grill falls a bit short temperature wise I occasionally elect to use the propane grill for the high searing heat I can dial up with ease. I wanted a charcoal grill that could reach 450-500 degrees reliably and still have structural durability for at least a few years. There is a cooking celebrity chef who has a tv show and they feature grilled meals. That chef uses the Weber Master-Touch grill. The features of the grill and ease of use on the show made me decide that I wanted that specific model. I am glad that I got it. The tolerances of my unit after assembly are snug and temperature control is easy. With my old durable grill I have to glove up if I want to adjust airflow or I will burn myself. On the Weber there are handles and levers that enable airflow adjustment quickly without requiring protective gloves. I remain glad to own my old durable grill, but my new Weber Master-Touch has become the star of my grilling equipment.
Results.Title: The true Standard

Results.ReviewText: Super produit, satble, performant et plein de choix d'accessoires
Results.Title: Master-Touch

Results.ReviewText: Après une année complète d’utilisation, le Master Touch offre une excellente raison de profiter de la cuisson au charbon de bois.
Results.Title: Facilité et efficacité

Results.ReviewText: The first grill I ordered came so warped that none of the grill grates would fit. The lid also did not fit because it was all so warped. I even tried the grates and lid on my older grill and same issue. Nothing was even close, Then I got a replacement sent to me and this one had a 4”-5” gouge in the bottom bowl, deep enough it was down to the metal through the paint. I ended up sanding it down and applying some black high heat paint to the damage because I was beyond the point of needing a grill yesterday for things I had coming up and clearly the quality of Weber had gone to the trash. I also did not want to go through the hassle of breaking down a second grill to try and pack back up like I had to with the first one to ship back again, just to get third one with some other issue. Extremely disappointed as I own many Weber products and these two grills were awful. Quality and quality control have clearly gone right down the tubes. Packing and send it seems to be the new standard procedure. And now I’m stuck using one I had to repair and paint, just to use it because I have to have it for events coming up. Extremely disappointed. This was always my go to brand and now it’s my stead clear of brand.
Results.Title: Quality control has gone in the trash

Results.ReviewText: I simply love my new kettle. Had another charcoal grill at my place, but a kettle at the shared roof where I live and by using it every now and then I realized it was easier and better than mine. So I finally decided to get it. Is very easy to cook all my favorite meats and the capacity to retain heat is impressive.
Results.Title: Amazing charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Original grill that I purchased in April had defective base and lid. Lid only stayed on when placed in certain way on base. I contacted Weber and they sent new base and top that I assembled using  parts from original grill.
Results.Title: Review of charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Without a doubt you definitely get what you pay for when buying a weber grill. It’s superior quality reflects its decades of craftsmanship. This is why many weber grills last 20+ years. However there is always room for improvement. A few things that I wish Weber would consider Would benefit the modern user. I wish there was a port on the side where I could insert my wireless meat thermometer wires. Also a gasket on the lid would help when very low smoking temperatures are required. It would be nice for the factory thermometer that’s installed in the lid be relocated to the opposite side so that it would read the temperature closest to the exhaust vent. The way it is now the its always positioned above the hot coals when I am using the indirect cooking method. In addition it would be nice if there were a option for a shelf on the side or holes that are pre-drilled to where you can add a shelf. But like I said you get what you pay for and I mean this as the highest compliment, however I would be willing to pay more for items, I mention.
Results.Title: You get what you pay for

Results.ReviewText: I can't believe I waited so long to get one of these grills. It is so well thought out and built to last. Little things like the flip up grates, cleaning system and lid holder make it so much easier to use. I love the quality of the bowl itself, it really holds the heat when you are doing a long smoke.
Results.Title: Awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic kettle!! Well built and well designed. There are several accessories that can be used with this and is functional.
Results.Title: This Kettlehead loves his Master-Touch!!!

Results.ReviewText: It arrived damaged; the lid was badly scratched/dinged.  I tried to ignore it (hate filing claims, etc) but it bugged me so badly after a week I contacted BBQ Guys who told me how to follow up with Weber, and it got resolved after a few emails and photos.  I received the new lid yesterday.  Am even more in love with Weber now.  We had our last Weber for 30+ years before updating this year, am glad I followed up to complain about the damage and grateful Weber made things right.   Thank you.
Results.Title: 22" Weber in the most beautiful blue color...

Results.ReviewText: Hands down the best kettle grill on the market. The ease of disposing ashes is perfect and makes it easy to maintain a clean grill
Results.Title: Best buy

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill however I have concerns about the quality of manufacturing process and the choice of materials chosen for the manufacturing of the grill. Welds broke on the main grill grid. I used the warranty to replace it, and the wrong part was sent which will be addressed later today. Also, the washers used for the handle are cheap will not stand the test of time. Also had to use the warranty to have those replaced after only 2 uses. However my overall satisfaction with the grill is very high! All the features are great! I know I’ll be grilling on this grill for years to come!
Results.Title: Amazing Grill but some poorly made hardware

Results.ReviewText:
I had a gas grill for many years and recently switched back to the good charcoal taste after a friend told me that he has one for 24 years. I didn't use the gas grill for two reasons. First, taste of food. Second, the cleaning. I got my charcoal grill as a present in June 2022. This is my review to the Master-Touch:

Construction is of high quality, grills are of heavy gauge as well as bowl and lid. Excellent construction quality and stiff. Handles have good grip and stable. Size is compact (ours is 22") but yet adequate for our family. No wonder my friend still have his after so many years.

Because the size, you can cook more than dozen of hamburgers at a time or eight large pork chops. When is time to clean, the ash catcher is the number one. No messy cleaning! Just scrape the ashes to the catcher with a plastic scraper and wash the bowl. II wash the bowl and lid with a non-abrasive dishwashing soap and a soft brush to preserve finish. 

When storing, don't forget to get a cover to protect it. It will last longer.
Results.Title: I Switched Back to Charcoal

Results.ReviewText: Acheter et utiliser et bien apprécié parfais pour debutant et expérimenter également, sky is the limit !!!

Results.ReviewText: Best ever inexpensive charcoal grill. It is easy to use , clean and cooks efficiently. Quality lid and bowl. Easy to adjust dampers for various degrees of heat.

Results.ReviewText: Love absolutely everything about how it cooks and its possibilities, variations, etc., except the stability of the legs. I wish they were solid or a thicker gauge. But that's it! I'd still buy more!
Results.Title: Love it! I just wish legs were more stabile.

Results.ReviewText: Holding out hope that what a rep told me isn't true....yet. He said to keep my proof of purchase as the blue paint is not holding up very well!

Results.ReviewText: WoW mon premier mes pas mon dernier. Une patte croche mais je suis convaincu qu’il vont me la changer vue le bon service

Results.ReviewText: Very impressed with my new Master-Touch Charcoal Grill 22”. It replaced my 22 Year Old Weber Original. My old Grill gave me many years of Good Grilling. Like the improvements with the New Grill, better Control of lower Air Vent, lid holder works very well and the Thermometer is a Good Feature. Very well-made Grill. Highly recommend it.
Results.Title: New Master-Touch Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Had an issue with one of the parts during assembly.  Unfortunately, it needed to be replaced, so I called Weber customer service.  I can honestly say it was the best customer service experience I have had in last 10 years.  Customer service representative was polite, professional, seemed understanding, and came up with a quick solution at no cost to me.  I will buy Weber for the rest of my life if their customer service stays this good.  Also the grill is great!
Results.Title: Broken part. No problem.

Love this grill.
Only problem is the wire brace/support by the wheels has one wire not welded. Over looked it and moving on.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
